snippet.description:
Republicans are spending so much money trying to define Texas Senate candidate James Talarico, but he’s been successful in raising money to get his message to Texans individually. So how far exactly does money go in a midterm race? 

Vox’s Astead Herndon discusses the impact of funding with New York Times national political correspondent Shane Goldmacher.
